replacement.title: PetMeds Order-Level Source Routing
replacement.definition: Keep PetMeds order-level metrics routed through their designated separate connector rather than migrating them through the general PetMeds BigQuery source.

patches.decision_note: Order-level source routing is independently testable and is explicitly excluded from the general PetMeds source-cutover Requirement.

replacement.title: Impact Page Source Exclusion
replacement.definition: Exclude the hidden Impact page from the dashboard source migration.

patches.decision_note: The source-exclusion decision is independently meaningful even though the supplied evidence does not identify which dashboard owns the Impact page.
